title: Max Visits the Library
author: Shellfie original
credit: An original story written for the McKinley Bulldogs.

pages: It is library day! Max's class walks to the McKinley library.
There are books on every shelf. Big books. Small books. Funny books.
"You may pick one book," says the librarian.
Max looks at a book about trucks. Vroom!
Max looks at a book about bugs. Buzz!
Then Max finds a book about a turtle. Max loves turtles!
The librarian scans the book. Beep!
"Please bring it back next week," she says.
Max reads the book at home with Grandma.
Next week, Max brings it back. Now it is time for a new book!

quiz.ev: Then Max finds a book about a turtle.

quiz.q: Why does Max bring the book back?
o: So Max can get a new book
